ideas.title: The Secret iPhone Code for Law Enforcement Tracking
ideas.angle: The video shows a viewer typing a specific code into their keypad to reveal if their call forwarding is secretly active. This is an interactive 'Check Right Now' challenge that forces the viewer to stay until the result appears, while the comment section will be flooded with people sharing their status (Enabled vs. Disabled).

hook.en: Type star-hash-twenty-one-hash into your phone right now.

ideas.reason: Privacy and 'hidden surveillance' topics are currently exploding on TikTok and Reels. Using a specific MMI code (Man-Machine Interface) provides immediate interactive gratification and high VVSA because users perform the action while the video plays.

ideas.title: How AI Detects Lying Through Your Eyes
ideas.angle: Shows how modern AI 'Eye-Tracking' tech can detect a lie in 0.1 seconds by measuring pupil dilation. It challenges the viewer to try and keep their pupils still while thinking of a lie, which is biologically impossible, creating a 'Brain Glitch' effect.

hook.en: AI knows you're lying before you even speak.

ideas.reason: Converges the 'Insane AI' pillar with 'Bizarre Body Science'. AI-driven surveillance and biometric 'unmasking' are high-anxiety, high-curiosity topics that drive long retention and debate in comments about privacy.

ideas.title: The 10-Second Digital Blind Spot Test
ideas.angle: An interactive vision test where the viewer stares at a yellow dot while a phone icon moves into their 'blind spot' and disappears. It reveals how the brain 'auto-fills' missing digital information, explaining how we miss obvious UI changes or 'dark patterns' on screens.

hook.en: Close your left eye and stare at this dot.

ideas.reason: Interactive physical tests (Archetype 1) have the highest APV because the viewer's success depends on watching the full loop. This specific 'blind spot' test is a classic psychological phenomenon rebranded for the 'Digital Survival' niche.
